warning.titlePre: Land Rover Velar D300 Timing Chain & Oil Dilution
paragraphs: Velar D300 engines — and other Ingenium diesel variants in the range — commonly show timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
*include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern (per G-BRF). This pattern is confirmed for the D300 and other Ingenium diesel variants, as per the VRF.*
